📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing`
This is occurrence #53. Self-recovering AMQP publish-hits gap, benign shape (matches 51 prior occurrences).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `DevOps` (`@devops` / `#team-devops`) — inert text per Hard rule #13. (Ownership-by-Project row says "Integrations" but no active team by that name exists in ownership.md; KB entry itself frames this as an Integrations/DevOps joint concern.)
Playbook: 1) Confirm DD monitor 296641466 in No Data state. 2) ALWAYS check sibling P1 monitors first — 296632224 (Event ingest stopped), 296636101 (Kafka events stopped) — if both OK, core EDA pipeline is healthy. 3) Confirm service:eda_consumer status:error returns 0 in DD Logs. 4) If siblings also fire, escalate immediately (real EDA-stack outage). 5) Not actionable on a single occurrence — this entry exists so repeats are recognized quickly.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no Slack permalink available):
  • https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466 (OK, recovered 2026-08-17T10:39:27Z)
  • Sibling P1 monitors (both OK throughout): https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296632224, https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296636101
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aeda_consumer%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1786952367&end=1786963167 — publish-hits gapped ~44min (09:53–10:37Z), then resumed
  • DD logs (0 errors during gap): service:eda_consumer status:error, 09:53–10:39Z
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this KB, not ES
